sources.title: H. Yunus Apaydın, el-Muhallâ, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
sources.support: Opening discussion identifies Ibn Hazm’s four legal works and the two direct commentary pairs. Survival and completion must be treated separately.

sources.title: Hayreddin Karaman, Caʿferiyye, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
sources.support: Section E, Literatür: title–author bibliography. Uṣūl and hadith compilations are excluded from this fiqh subset.

sources.title: Mustafa Öz, Tûsî, Ebû Caʿfer, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
sources.support: Life and Eserleri / Fıkıh: author death, al-Mabsut, al-Nihaya, al-Khilaf and al-Jumal wa-l-uqud; Nukat commentary.

sources.title: Mazlum Uyar, Hillî, Muhakkık, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
sources.support: Eserleri 1–3: Sharaʾiʿ, its abridgment al-Nafiʿ, commentaries, and Nukat on Tusi. Author death distinguished from Allama Hilli.

sources.title: Şehîd-i Evvel, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
sources.support: Life and Eserleri A.1: al-Lumʿa, conflicting composition reports, and al-Rawda commentary.

sources.title: Mustafa Öz, Şehîd-i Sânî, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
sources.support: Eserleri 6–7 explicitly identify al-Rawda and Masalik as commentaries. Death year 966/1559 is qualified by the source.

sources.title: Ahmet Özel, Ensârî, Şeyh Murtaza, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
sources.support: Author death 1281/1864; Eserleri 2 and 4 identify al-Makasib and al-Manasik. Life gives Najafi’s death 1266/1850.

sources.title: Yusuf Gökalp and Fatih Yücel, Zeydiyye, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
sources.support: Fiqh section, Literatür: al-Hadi’s three works; al-Azhar, al-Bahr and Ibn Miftah’s commentary.

sources.title: Saffet Köse, Hâdî-İlelhak, Yahyâ b. Hüseyin, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
sources.support: Author death 298/911 and legal bibliography; his pupils’ role in transmitting/compiling answers is distinguished from authorship.

sources.title: Cengiz Kallek, el-Bahrü’z-Zehhâr, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
sources.support: Author death 840/1437; named commentaries Ghayat al-afkar, al-Qamar al-nawwar and Nafahat al-anzar.

sources.title: Ethem Ruhi Fığlalı, İbâzıyye, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
sources.support: Section E: legal bibliography identifies the two Mudawwanas, al-Idah, al-Nil, al-Wird al-bassam and the Nil commentary.

sources.title: Sabri Hizmetli, Ettafeyyiş, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
sources.support: Author death 1332/1914; Eserleri D identifies the Nil commentary and Shamil al-asl wa-l-farʿ.
